question: What expansion rate and physical distance does flat matter-plus-Lambda cosmology predict at the declared redshifts?

origin.description: A small execution-path example inspired by the historical expansion studies; no Prospector paper has been admitted.

assumptions: Spatially flat FLRW; matter plus cosmological constant, no radiation.
Omega_m=0.3 and H0=70 km/s/Mpc are chosen controls, not fitted measurements.
limitations: No observed data, fitting, uncertainty inference or survey simulation.
A successful numerical contract does not validate the model or reproduce the historical manuscript.
